text: Because the CHARITYxDAO records governance on distributed ledger technology, all governance votes and endowment allocation decisions are fully publicly visible, auditable by the public at will, and immutable once on chain.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021

abstract: Through the use of DLT technology, all governance votes and endowment allocation decisions are fully publicly visible and can be audited by the public at will. Moreover, all onchain data is immutable and can be accessed by the public.
